_comment: S6 (max): the 110,202 fractions with 768 columns APPENDED, being the per-dimension maximum over the frozen DNABERT-2 descriptions of the unitigs the sample contains. Non-linear in the fractions, which is the point: appending a fraction-weighted SUM would span only functions the first layer could already express. Every private per-unitig weight vector is kept, unlike S4 and S5, which replaced them and lost 0.208 to 0.359 on held-out. The appended block is standardised on this fold's four TRAINING folds only and rescaled to the fraction block's spread. Acceptance checks before the run: 122 structural and leakage checks passed, and the block carries about 12 effective dimensions of between-sample variation with 0 dead columns. Held-out untouched.
